Tooltip_craft_smokerDesc:
Add fuel and light it like a campfire. Food prepared for smoking (salt-cured meat or fish, or cheese) turns into smoked food after about 11.5 hours of fire (cheese: 4 hours). It holds up to 12 hours of fuel, so one load lasts a whole run. Smoked food left in the burning smoker for 2 more hours gets burnt.
Smoked food keeps for weeks and is ready to eat. Heated anywhere else, prepared meat or fish just gets cooked.
